--- create_property_graph_quoted_schema_tables.sql
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH G
NODE TABLES (`order`.`group` AS Person)
EDGE TABLES (
  `order`.`select` AS Relation
    SOURCE KEY (Src) REFERENCES Person (Id)
    DESTINATION KEY (Dst) REFERENCES Person (Id)
)

--- AST

  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 22,
    NameEnd: 23,
    Name:    "G",
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   24,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   36,
        Rparen:   62,
        Elements: []*ast.PropertyGraphElement{

              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 37,

            },

          },
        },
      },
    },
    EdgeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphEdgeTables{

--- SQL
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH G NODE TABLES (`order`.`group` AS Person) EDGE TABLES (`order`.`select` AS Relation SOURCE KEY (Src) REFERENCES Person (Id) DESTINATION KEY (Dst) REFERENCES Person (Id))
